summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (ipns-signature-verify-coverage) of CipherBox using the GSD workflow: research → plan (4 plans, 2 waves) → verify → execute all plans → phase verification.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully. Phase verifier passed 7/7 must-haves, SDK E2E gate cleared 89/89 (including the historically fragile D-09 tightening class), and advisory code review findings were queued for application. VERIFICATION.md written with status: passed.

repo: crates/crypto cannot dev-depend on api-client/core, so the Rust cross-language verify-vector consumer must live in crates/fuse/tests/ rather than crates/crypto/tests/
API .env has TEST_LOGIN_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-ci-only; SDK E2E suite defaults to e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-in-production — these must be aligned before running SDK E2E locally
D-09 sequence-validation tightening class previously broke 48/89 SDK E2E tests; treat any change to upsertFolderIpns sequence enforcement as high regression risk
apps/api line 245 expectedSequenceNumber guard is intentionally kept as the CAS 409 conflict check — do not remove when adding D-09 non-CAS enforcement
Local stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was confirmed running during this session; SDK E2E can be run locally when stack is up

code.finding: New resolve_ipns_verified chokepoint added here; imports ciborium — crates/fuse/Cargo.toml must declare ciborium as a dependency or builds fail
expectedSequenceNumber guard at this line is the CAS 409 conflict check — distinct from D-09 non-CAS sequence gate; intentionally preserved during 58-02
Uses unchecked seq + 1 arithmetic; crate convention is checked_add — flagged as WR-01 in code review, should be fixed for overflow safety

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch is safer than parallel worktree execution for security/crypto phases — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees
gsd commit helper commit_failed is a known false negative; always verify with git log rather than retrying the commit
RESEARCH.md Open Questions section must be marked (RESOLVED) or plan checker emits a warning; fix is a one-line heading rename, no replanning needed
GSD executor subagents can overrun their plan boundary and execute the next plan in the same run — always check git log after each executor returns to confirm which plans actually landed
Plan checker scoring: 0 blockers with only cosmetic warnings is a green-light for execution without a planner revision cycle

friction: 58-01 executor hit an API socket error (connection closed) mid-execution, dropping mid-task-4 with uncommitted work and no SUMMARY.md — required a manual continuation agent
58-02 executor silently continued into 58-03 without being asked, executing two plans in one run with no boundary signal
SDK E2E gate silently skipped during 58-02 execution due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch (401 on test-login); required a separate focused agent to run it properly after the fact
test-login endpoint body shape was not obvious — curl probes with guessed payloads returned 400, making it hard to diagnose the secret mismatch interactively
commit_failed false negative from gsd commit helper required an extra git log verification step on every commit
open_items: Code review findings (WR-01: unchecked seq+1 in replay.rs, plus 3 robustness/parity findings) were queued for a code-fixer agent at session end — transcript ends before confirmation they were applied and re-tested
--no-transition flag was active, so phase transition to the next phase was intentionally suppressed and must be triggered separately
